tags.feature: The restricted zone for players in [i]Survivor[/i] mode is now visible.
Added a [i]Spectator Mode[/i] interface.
Spectators can move freely and watch battles.
It is still possible to leave the match using the menu buttons.
Added a UI hint during [i]Battle Royale[/i] cooldown indicating that pressing [b]F5[/b] displays the spell information of both your character and your spirit.
New map: Lavalon !

Fixed monster push: monsters now fall smoothly.

tags.feature: Shop rework.

Added a timer and visual display of ongoing matchmaking, even when switching pages.
It is now possible to use mouse scroll in the character gallery.
Killing a player now grants 10 additional souls and heals 15 health points.

Kyren’s illustrations have been redone.
Niklaus’s illustration has been updated.
Guldir’s illustration has been updated.
New character: [b]Kyren[/b] is now available. Discover the Anti-Magic Templar!
Added a leaderboard for Survivor mode.
Added a leaderboard for Battle Royale mode.

tags.balance_change: Monsters are now affected by pull / knockback spells.
Some Survivor mode monster spells have been adjusted.
The *Dragon Charge* spell can only hit the same enemy once.
The *Tornado* spell now deals less damage.

notes.title: Patchnote – Update [v3.0.005]
notes.content: [h1]Patchnote – Update \[v3.0.005][/h1][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]- Fixed the floating value of EXP in the match recap.[/p][p]- The “New record” text and records for Battle Royale are now correct (the lower the rank, the better).[/p][p]- The “Nouveau record” text will no longer appear for now.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where home screen buttons could be highlighted at the same time.[/p][p]- Fixed the “Quit Game” button clicking on “Leave Group” instead.[/p][p]- Players should no longer be affected by other players' attacks in Survivor mode, even if they are not in the same group.[/p][p]- Survivor: fixed the damage bonus and changed it from +2% to +5%.[/p][p]- Survivor: fixed the cooldown reduction bonus and changed it from +2% to +5%.[/p][p]- Survivor: fixed the number of health points gained which was higher than the number of bonuses collected.[/p][p]- Monsters will no longer be blocked by invisible walls at the edges of the Survivor map.[/p][p]- General: the number of health points displayed at the start of the game is no longer 0/0.[/p][h2] New Features & Improvements[/h2][p]- Added a visual indicator and sound effect when a player is killed, displaying the name of the killed and the killer.[/p][p]- Matchmaking: instead of “players waiting: X / players missing: Y”, it now displays “Searching for players: X/Y” (Y being the total number of players required to start).[/p][p]- Survivor: removed the one-minute wait before starting the match. The match now starts instantly (unlike Battle Royale).[/p][p]- Survivor & Battle Royale: monsters now lose collision immediately upon death, making it easier to collect souls in Battle Royale.[/p][p]- Discord: the “Now Playing” status is now displayed.[/p][p]- Removed irrelevant / undeveloped modes from the mode selection list.[/p][p]- Restructured the sound system.[/p][p]- Added music to the authentication screen.[/p][p]- Added music to the main menu.[/p][p]- Added sounds for:[/p][p]  - Button hover[/p][p]  - Button unhover[/p][p]  - Button enable/disable[/p][p]  - Button click[/p][p]  - Matchmaking: searching for players[/p][p]  - Matchmaking: match start[/p][p]  - Matchmaking: added a button to cancel the search[/p][p]  - Soul collection[/p][p]- Added a zone reduction timer.[/p][p]- Added a pre-zone reduction countdown.[/p][p]- If the maximum number of players is reached for a match, the one-minute wait is skipped and players are instantly teleported. Otherwise, the one-minute wait remains.[/p][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][p]- **Diaby**: increased auto-attack damage.[/p][p]- **Dash**:[/p][p]  - Cooldown: 5 seconds → 3 seconds.[/p][p]  - Velocity: 12 → 15.[/p][p]- Survivor: removed the ability to stun allies.[/p][p]- Battle Royale: maximum lives obtained per soul increased from 3 to 5.[/p][p]- General: default player health increased from 100 to 250.[/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed the floating value of EXP in the match recap.
- The “New record” text and records for Battle Royale are now correct (the lower the rank, the better).
- The “Nouveau record” text will no longer appear for now.
- Fixed an issue where home screen buttons could be highlighted at the same time.
- Fixed the “Quit Game” button clicking on “Leave Group” instead.
- Players should no longer be affected by other players' attacks in Survivor mode, even if they are not in the same group.
- Survivor: fixed the damage bonus and changed it from +2% to +5%.
- Survivor: fixed the cooldown reduction bonus and changed it from +2% to +5%.
- Survivor: fixed the number of health points gained which was higher than the number of bonuses collected.
- Monsters will no longer be blocked by invisible walls at the edges of the Survivor map.
- General: the number of health points displayed at the start of the game is no longer 0/0.

tags.feature: - Added a visual indicator and sound effect when a player is killed, displaying the name of the killed and the killer.
- Matchmaking: instead of “players waiting: X / players missing: Y”, it now displays “Searching for players: X/Y” (Y being the total number of players required to start).
- Survivor: removed the one-minute wait before starting the match. The match now starts instantly (unlike Battle Royale).
- Survivor & Battle Royale: monsters now lose collision immediately upon death, making it easier to collect souls in Battle Royale.
- Discord: the “Now Playing” status is now displayed.
- Removed irrelevant / undeveloped modes from the mode selection list.
- Restructured the sound system.
- Added music to the authentication screen.
- Added music to the main menu.

- Added sounds for:
  - Button hover
  - Button unhover
  - Button enable/disable
  - Button click
  - Matchmaking: searching for players
  - Matchmaking: match start
  - Matchmaking: added a button to cancel the search
  - Soul collection
- Added a zone reduction timer.
- Added a pre-zone reduction countdown.
- If the maximum number of players is reached for a match, the one-minute wait is skipped and players are instantly teleported. Otherwise, the one-minute wait remains.

tags.balance_change: - Survivor: removed the ability to stun allies.
- Battle Royale: maximum lives obtained per soul increased from 3 to 5.
- General: default player health increased from 100 to 250.
